content:
maria: Hey — need a short-lived console elevation to rotate a long-lived service token for svc-search-indexer in prod-us-west. Token was flagged by alerting as used from an unknown IP, want to rotate, replace in deployment, then revoke old token. Should take ~12m.
maria: Ticket INC-3421 created with context and screenshots.
ryan: @maria please paste the exact commands you'll run and confirm you won't paste secrets into channels or public logs.
maria: Commands I'll run (will use local tmp files + sops):
```
kubectl -n platform get secret svc-search-indexer -o yaml > /tmp/old-secret.yaml
# generate new token payload -> /tmp/new-secret.yaml
kubectl -n platform apply -f /tmp/new-secret.yaml
kubectl -n platform rollout status deploy/search-indexer
kubectl -n platform delete secret svc-search-indexer-old
```
I will not paste any secret material in Slack.
sec-bot: Policy check: per short-lived elevation rules, we need justification, ticket id, scope limited to required roles, and a timebox. Also ensure CloudTrail + KMS audit enabled.
ops-lead: I can approve a 15-minute console sudo window for maria limited to AssumeRole(admin-temp) + kms:Decrypt on redwood-prod-keys. No SSH, no DB creds.
alex: Can I be added as an observer for the window? I'll stand by to assist rollback if needed.
maria: Requesting: role=arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/admin-temp, kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/redwood-prod-keys, duration=900s. Justification: rotate possibly compromised svc token referenced in INC-3421.
ryan: Approve for 900s. @ops-lead you good to grant?
ops-lead: Approved for 15m (900s). Granting now. NOTE: run `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=AssumeRole` after rotation and post the event IDs to the ticket.
maria: Starting rotation now, will follow checklist and ping back when complete :lock:
maria: Rotation complete. New token deployed, rollout successful, old secret removed, verified no 5xx in logs for the indexer.
ops-lead: Confirmed rollout status and no anomalous errors in logs. Revoking elevated role now.
sec-bot: Elevation window closed and audit appended to INC-3421: https://audit.redwood.example/evt/INC-3421. Recorded actions: AssumeRole, KMS Decrypt, SecretUpdate.
maria: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
